related.title: EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念
related.titleEn: EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept
related.transfer: 可遷移「束斑上的功率密度」與「材料損傷的累積時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power density in the beam footprint" and "Time to accumulate material damage" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以加速器模擬融合中子：五百萬瓦氘束、液態鋰靶、材料損傷累積與可用率；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念則以由 ITER 到電網：電廠功率平衡、包覆層壽命與更換、氚自給與脈衝運轉的儲熱為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on simulating fusion neutrons with an accelerator: a five-megawatt deuteron beam, a liquid-lithium target, accumulating material damage and availability; EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept centres on from ITER to the grid: plant power balance, blanket life and replacement, tritium self-sufficiency and thermal storage for pulsed operation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「五百萬瓦的氘束」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「離心力對鋰的增壓」的模型移到EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「中子壁負載」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "A five-megawatt deuteron beam" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Pressurising lithium by centrifugal force" to EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Neutron wall loading", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「束斑上的功率密度」與「材料損傷的累積時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；EU-DEMO 示範融合電廠概念的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power density in the beam footprint" and "Time to accumulate material damage" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of EU-DEMO Demonstration Fusion Power Plant Concept must be respecified.

related.title: ITER 國際磁約束研究工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「束斑上的功率密度」與「材料損傷的累積時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power density in the beam footprint" and "Time to accumulate material damage" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以加速器模擬融合中子：五百萬瓦氘束、液態鋰靶、材料損傷累積與可用率；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程則以國際熱核融合實驗堆的定量檢核：真空室扇段、七方實物貢獻、分階段運轉與破裂緩解為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on simulating fusion neutrons with an accelerator: a five-megawatt deuteron beam, a liquid-lithium target, accumulating material damage and availability; ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering centres on quantitative checks of ITER: vacuum-vessel sectors, in-kind contributions of seven members, staged operation and disruption mitigation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「五百萬瓦的氘束」與「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的能量輸入、轉換路徑與主要環境條件。
把本課「離心力對鋰的增壓」的模型移到ITER 國際磁約束研究工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「三乘積與點火條件」為例，設計一項能區分兩個工程行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list energy inputs, conversion paths and main environmental conditions of "A five-megawatt deuteron beam" and "Device size and plasma volume".
Move the model of "Pressurising lithium by centrifugal force" to ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Triple product and the ignition condition", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two projects and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.
related.why: 可遷移「束斑上的功率密度」與「材料損傷的累積時間」的定量模型、量測與驗證方法；ITER 國際磁約束研究工程的資源條件、容量、設備與允收條件需重新設定。
related.whyEn: The quantitative models, measurement and verification methods of "Power density in the beam footprint" and "Time to accumulate material damage" transfer, while resource conditions, capacity, equipment and acceptance conditions of ITER international magnetic-confinement engineering must be respecified.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: IFMIF-DONES 融合材料中子源
history.text: 2007 年日歐更廣泛途徑協定啟動工程驗證與設計；2017 年西班牙格拉納達被選為歐洲候選廠址；2019 年LIPAc 達到 5 MeV、125 mA 的氘束；2023 年進入建造階段。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計或運轉文件。
history.textEn: 2007: The Japan–Europe Broader Approach launched engineering validation and design. 2017: Granada in Spain was chosen as the European candidate site. 2019: LIPAc reached a deuteron beam of 5 MeV and 125 mA. 2023: The construction phase began. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design or operating documents.
